newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-TASSOTTI FACES FINAL MATCH FOR MILAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TASSOTTI FACES FINAL MATCH FOR MILAN.

text.p: Veteran defender Mauro Tassotti will play his last game for AC Milan on Sunday after 17 consecutive seasons at the club and 404 serie A matches.

"This has been a season of transition for me. Now I'm ready for a career as a coach," the 37-year-old former Italian international, who spent his first two seasons at Lazio, told reporters at Milan's training ground on Saturday.
Tassotti, who was persuaded to stay on for another season after intending to quit last year, said he wanted to start his coaching career with Milan's youth team.
Milan host relegation-threatened Cagliari in their final league match of the season on Sunday.
